Supreme Court hears Tarun Tejpal's appeal against rape conviction

India's Supreme Court has issued a notice seeking a response from the Goa government regarding journalist Tarun Tejpal's appeal against his conviction in a 2013 rape case. Tejpal was sentenced to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment. His appeal challenges both the conviction and the sentence.
